_note: v2.4 plan 09 acceptance row I3 (foreign emitter), written 2026-09-25 from live-v24-01-foreign.json (plan 01's live fixture, unchanged otherwise) because the row names three blocks and an unpaired STARTED, and the base fixture planted no nudge and sent no unpaired STARTED, so those halves were vacuous there. Added: (1) a copilot one-turn nudge is set before the baseline is taken, and the byte-identical comparison of the injected blocks is widened from story_orchestrator_* to every story_* key (the nudge is injected as story_copilot_nudge, which the base fixture's filter did not see), so the comparison after the foreign {source} run around a REAL request (extraction profile, PONG) covers the private, nudge, note (and any guidance) blocks; (2) the test-only emitter's dryUnpaired() (an ST-shaped dry STARTED that is never closed) must leave every block, the nudge and the drafted private block untouched; (3) the final check also asserts the nudge is kept after the {source} STARTED/STOPPED; the nudge is cleared before it is set, because a nudge left by an earlier failed run in the same page is deduped by stHost/extensionPrompts.ts (acceptance finding, v24-acc-A-extprompt-cache.json) and would make this setup step fail for a reason that is not this row's; (4) a control after the fixture's own ST-shaped STOPPED closes the loud generation: the nudge must then be cleared, which proves the kept-nudge checks could fail. The emitter mimics Guided Generations' shape (X10, X26); GG is not installed, so this proves the shape predicate, not interop with a real GG install. Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v24-acc-I3.json --sandbox --group 1759606632088.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0 }); rt.setEpistemicLedgerCapable(true); if (!rt.getSnapshot().memory.settings.epistemicLedgerCapable) throw new Error('the epistemic/ledger capability did not stick'); return { cadence: 0, capable: true };

steps.send: I count the guild's takings while Ponticius is looking at the board.

extract.debugResponse:
SCENE_NONE
[hiding] Arin from Ponticius | Arin palmed the guild's petty cash while nobody was counting.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); if (!ctx.groupId) throw new Error('not a group chat: a private block is staged per drafted member only in a group, so this probe measures nothing'); const rows = rt.getEpistemic().filter((entry) => entry.hiddenFrom === 'Ponticius' && !entry.supersededBy); if (rows.length !== 1) throw new Error(`the private fact did not land exactly once: ${JSON.stringify(rt.getEpistemic().map((e) => [e.tag, e.subject, e.hiddenFrom, e.content]))}`); const chid = (ctx.characters ?? []).findIndex((card) => card?.name === 'Arin'); if (chid < 0) throw new Error(`Arin is not a character here: ${JSON.stringify((ctx.characters ?? []).map((c) => c?.name))}`); const state = rt.getStagecraftState(); const text = 'Continuity: established - the T6 probe fact. Keep the next reply consistent with it.'; const last = ctx.chat.length - 1; globalThis.__t6 = { chid, text, settings: { ...state.settings } }; state.settings.wardenEnabled = true; state.settings.wardenAcceptMode = 'auto'; state.proposals.push({ id: 't6-probe-note', curator: 'warden', at: new Date().toISOString(), boundary: rt.getEngineState().boundary, messageId: last, checkpointId: rt.getEngineState().activeCheckpointId, reason: 'continuity', summary: 'T6 probe note', mode: 'auto', ops: [{ op: { kind: 'note', text, facts: ['the T6 probe fact'], replyMessageId: last }, status: 'accepted' }], dropped: [] }); if (ctx.extensionPrompts?.story_orchestrator_continuity?.value) throw new Error('a continuity note is already injected before any generation opened'); return { chid, planted: 't6-probe-note', scope: 'warden switched on in the in-memory settings view only; nothing install-wide is written' };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); await ctx.eventSource.emit(ctx.eventTypes.GROUP_MEMBER_DRAFTED, globalThis.__t6.chid); const block = String(rt.getAppliedEpistemicBlock()); if (!block.includes('petty cash')) throw new Error(`drafting Arin did not stage his private block, so the probe below would measure nothing: ${JSON.stringify(block.slice(0, 300))}`); return { drafted: globalThis.__t6.chid, staged: true };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); rt.clearCopilotNudge(); rt.setCopilotNudge("Nudge: the I3 probe nudge. Let the next reply mention the rain on the guild roof.", 1); globalThis.__i3Nudge = rt.getActiveNudge(); if (!globalThis.__i3Nudge) throw new Error('the copilot nudge did not stick, so the nudge half of this probe would measure nothing'); const injectedAs = Object.entries(Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(ctx.extensionPrompts ?? {}).filter(([key]) => key.startsWith('story_')).map(([key, value]) => [key, String(value?.value ?? '')]))).filter(([, value]) => value.includes('I3 probe nudge')).map(([key]) => key); if (!injectedAs.length) throw new Error('setting the nudge injected no story_* block, so the byte-identical comparison below would not cover it'); return { nudge: globalThis.__i3Nudge, injectedAs };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); globalThis.__foreignLiveBefore = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(ctx.extensionPrompts ?? {}).filter(([key]) => key.startsWith('story_')).map(([key, value]) => [key, String(value?.value ?? '')])); return { keys: Object.keys(globalThis.__foreignLiveBefore) };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const profileId = rt.getGlobalSettings().extraction?.profileId; if (!profileId) throw new Error('no extraction profile is selected, so there is no real request to send'); const outcome = await globalThis.__soForeignEmitter.run({ request: async () => { const reply = await ctx.ConnectionManagerRequestService.sendRequest(profileId, [{ role: 'user', content: 'Reply with exactly: PONG' }], 16, { extractData: true, includePreset: true, includeInstruct: true, stream: false }, {}); return reply ?? ''; } }); if (!outcome.answered) throw new Error('the foreign request got no answer: ' + JSON.stringify(outcome)); const after = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(ctx.extensionPrompts ?? {}).filter(([key]) => key.startsWith('story_')).map(([key, value]) => [key, String(value?.value ?? '')])); const changed = [...new Set([...Object.keys(after), ...Object.keys(globalThis.__foreignLiveBefore)])].filter((key) => (after[key] ?? '') !== (globalThis.__foreignLiveBefore[key] ?? '')); if (changed.length) throw new Error('a foreign {source} run around a real request changed our blocks: ' + changed.join(', ')); return { ...outcome, unchanged: Object.keys(after).length };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const outcome = await globalThis.__soForeignEmitter.dryUnpaired(); const after = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(ctx.extensionPrompts ?? {}).filter(([key]) => key.startsWith('story_')).map(([key, value]) => [key, String(value?.value ?? '')])); const changed = [...new Set([...Object.keys(after), ...Object.keys(globalThis.__foreignLiveBefore)])].filter((key) => (after[key] ?? '') !== (globalThis.__foreignLiveBefore[key] ?? '')); if (changed.length) throw new Error('an unpaired dry STARTED changed our blocks: ' + changed.join(', ')); if (rt.getActiveNudge() !== globalThis.__i3Nudge) throw new Error('an unpaired dry STARTED cleared the nudge'); if (!String(rt.getAppliedEpistemicBlock()).includes('petty cash')) throw new Error('an unpaired dry STARTED cleared the drafted private block'); return { ...outcome, unchanged: Object.keys(after).length };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const note = () => rt.getStagecraftState().proposals.find((record) => record.id === 't6-probe-note')?.ops?.[0]?.status ?? null; const injected = () => ctx.extensionPrompts?.story_orchestrator_continuity?.value ?? ''; const block = () => String(rt.getAppliedEpistemicBlock()); try { const problems = []; if (!block().includes('petty cash')) problems.push(`a foreign {source} emit cleared the drafted member's private block: ${JSON.stringify(block().slice(0, 200))}`); if (injected() !== globalThis.__t6.text) problems.push(`a foreign {source} emit removed the continuity note: ${JSON.stringify(injected())}`); if (note() !== 'accepted') problems.push(`the note was spent before the loud generation rendered anything: status ${note()}`); if (rt.getActiveNudge() !== globalThis.__i3Nudge) problems.push(`a foreign {source} emit cleared the copilot nudge: ${JSON.stringify(rt.getActiveNudge())}`); if (problems.length) throw new Error(problems.join(' | ')); return { block: 'kept', note: 'kept', nudge: 'kept' }; } finally { await ctx.eventSource.emit(ctx.eventTypes.GENERATION_STOPPED); const state = rt.getStagecraftState(); const index = state.proposals.findIndex((record) => record.id === 't6-probe-note'); if (index >= 0) state.proposals.splice(index, 1); Object.assign(state.settings, globalThis.__t6?.settings ?? {}); }

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const nudge = rt.getActiveNudge(); if (nudge !== null) { rt.clearCopilotNudge(); throw new Error(`control: the ST-shaped STOPPED that closed the loud generation did not clear the one-turn nudge, so the kept-nudge check above could not have failed: ${JSON.stringify(nudge)}`); } return { control: 'the ST-shaped close cleared the nudge' };
